simple.meaning: עַצֻּמָה (ʻatstsumâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a bulwark , i.e. (figuratively) argument.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

definitions.full: H6110. atsumah [ עֲצֻמָה ] noun feminine defence ; — plural suffix עֲצֻמוֺתֵיכֻם (so Baer Ginsb; van d. H. ׳עַצֻּמ ) Isa 41:21 bring forward your defences , defensive arguments (Che Hpt עַצְּבוֺתֵיכֻם your idols , after Gr, [so Lo Klo explain ׳עצמ , as mightiest aid, I. עצם ]).
